name: Unwelcome Visitors

angles.text: As a hunter, you can track and thin the overpopulated shrieklings in Shadowgale Forest. You take up the work of wardens and trappers, a duty the High Order disdains.
As a druid, you can see the shrieklings' sudden growth and spread as a disturbance in Shadowgale Forest. Swift action is needed to restore the forest's natural balance.

aliases: where to pick up unwelcome visitors
faq.answer: Iaadaria Bitterwind gives the request in Valanaar. She is a researcher with the High Order and asks travelers to hunt shrieklings nearby, gathering materials for her alchemical studies.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Unwelcome Visitors?

aliases: why does high order want talons
faq.answer: The High Order is interested in the shrieklings' talons, which have distinct alchemical properties. Though the Order usually leaves trapping and pest control to others, Iaadaria Bitterwind sees a chance to study valuable reagents while helping protect the region.
faq.q: What is the High Order's interest in the shrieklings?

faq.answer: The shrieklings in Shadowgale Forest have multiplied greatly in recent months. They are moving beyond their usual woodland territory, threatening neighboring areas if their spread continues.
faq.q: Why must the shriekling population be culled?

aliases: how to get to shadowgale forest
faq.answer: Shadowgale Forest lies near Valanaar. Its dangerous woods are usually forbidden to ordinary travelers and inexperienced adventurers because of the violent wildlife within.

aliases: what kind of beasts are shrieklings
faq.answer: Shrieklings are vicious predatory beasts native to Shadowgale Forest. Their talons have alchemical properties, and in recent months their numbers have grown so greatly that they are pushing beyond the forest's edge.

aliases: what do i need for unwelcome visitors
faq.answer: Travelers must bring eight Shriekling Talons from Shadowgale Forest to Iaadaria Bitterwind in Valanaar. The talons will aid her scholarly and alchemical research.
faq.q: What items are required to complete Unwelcome Visitors?

faq.answer: Shadowgale Forest is forbidden to ordinary adventurers because its wildlife is deadly and the woods are treacherous. Those who enter, including travelers asked to cull the shrieklings, must be ready for severe danger.
faq.q: Why is Shadowgale Forest off-limits to normal adventurers?

sections.body: Shadowgale Forest is a dangerous woodland that ordinary adventurers are forbidden to enter. Now its shrieklings have multiplied in numbers never seen before. They are pressing toward the forest's edge and extending their hunting grounds beyond the canopy. If they keep spreading, settled lands and travel routes will face a growing danger.
sections.title: The Shriekling Surge

sections.body: In Valanaar, Iaadaria Bitterwind of the High Order sees both danger and opportunity in the shrieklings' growing numbers. The Order usually leaves pest control and trapping to others. Yet shriekling talons have rare alchemical properties, making an exception worthwhile. Travelers are asked to enter Shadowgale Forest and bring back eight talons. The High Order can then help protect the region and study the reagents.
sections.title: Scholarly Culling

summary: In Shadowgale Forest, shrieklings are pressing toward the woods' edge. Iaadaria Bitterwind in Valanaar asks travelers to gather their talons for the High Order.
